Description: The AMQP module connects Decisions to any AMQP 1.0 broker (ActiveMQ Artemis, ActiveMQ Classic, RabbitMQ 4.x, Azure Service Bus, Apache Qpid, Solace). It listens to queues and topics through Decisions message queue handlers, with broker-side message filters (simple filter rules, JMS selectors, RabbitMQ SQL and stream filters, or custom AMQP filters), and provides steps to send, receive, and request/reply. Queue credentials can be updated from a flow, for example a scheduled flow that fetches rotating credentials from an identity provider; the queue then restarts on every server with the new credentials.
